QuestInfo.name: [NLC] You Know the Drill
QuestInfo.0: Glimmer Man used an unknown technology to send you to the base of the Cerberusians, and wants to wipe out any that remain. Hear what he has in mind.
QuestInfo.1: Glimmer Man used an unknown technology to send you to the base of the Cerberusians, and wants to wipe out any that remain. Hear what he has in mind.
QuestInfo.2: With Glimmer Man's help, you successfully destroyed the Cerberusians' gigantic drill. Though you still aren't sure what they were doing, at least they should pose no further threat.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Talk to #p9201083# in #m600000000# and destroy the gigantic drill.
